title: Gateway event stream
responsibility: Connects session events to a Responses-style server-sent event response and cancels unfinished sessions when the client disconnects.

inputs.name: gatewayStream.session
inputs.description: Mutable session receiving the event emitter and completed replay snapshot.

inputs.name: gatewayStream.repository
inputs.description: Session repository used to cancel unfinished work on request abort or stream cancellation.

inputs.name: gatewayStream.context
inputs.description: Optional replay key and abort signal associated with this request.

outputs.name: gatewayStream
outputs.description: No-store text/event-stream response. Startup, text and calls are serialized; done/error closes the stream, clears the emitter and optionally stores the complete replay. Client cancellation clears the emitter and cancels unfinished work.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: No direct ExpectedCliError throw appears in this implementation; repository cancellation or serialization may propagate errors.
